n: Capriasca 48-Inch Freestanding French Door Dual Fuel Range, 8 Burners, True Convection Oven
desc: Introducing the Forno Capriasca 48-Inch French Door Dual Fuel Range, which seamlessly blends professional styling and performance into your home kitchen with its durable stainless-steel design. The gas rangetop features eight sealed dual-ring brass burners with a total output of 160,000 BTU, perfect for everything from simmering sauces to melting chocolate.
hl: Sealed Dual-Ring Brass Burners can achieve high heat searing or delicate simmering control
Recessed Black Enamel Cooktop Cavity contains spills for quick clean-ups
Convenient left swing door for easy oven cavity access.
4.32 cu. Ft. True convection fan oven with 6,300 W total broil and bake output.

Includes 6 heavy-duty stainless steel telescopic oven racks, cast iron wok support, reversible grill/griddle, air fryer basket, rack & drip pan, rotisserie kit with skewer forks, LP conversion kit, and a NEMA 14-50P power cord.
Additional 2.26 cu. ft. oven with a 3,400 W broil and bake output.
